verdict.rationale: Grafana explicitly documents OpenTelemetry as a first-class open standard for instrumentation ('protecting you from vendor lock-in and ensuring data portability') and Tempo supports OTel/Jaeger/Zipkin protocols interchangeably, while Grafana's core value prop is querying/visualizing data 'wherever it's stored' across many data sources with per-query backend mixing. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of Grafana alerting/dashboards across many disparate backends (Graphite, InfluxDB, Prometheus, CloudWatch, PostgreSQL) without re-architecting the visualization layer. Missing for 10: a direct SRE case study of switching backends post-instrumentation without code changes, and clearer distinction between Grafana-the-visualizer vs. the OTel instrumentation layer itself.
